task: A scene collection has already been set up with three scenes: 'Scene 1', 'Scene 2', and 'Scene 3', each with a basic source. Your task is to rename the scenes and add new sources: 1. Rename 'Scene 1' to exactly 'Main View'. (Right-click the scene name and select Rename.) 2. Rename 'Scene 2' to exactly 'Closeup'. 3. Rename 'Scene 3' to exactly 'Wide Shot'. 4. Select the 'Main View' scene. Add a Text (FreeType 2) source named exactly 'Overlay Text'. 5. Select the 'Wide Shot' scene. Add a Color Source named exactly 'Stage Light'. 6. Make sure all sources (old and new) are visible. 7. Do NOT create or delete any scenes. The collection should still have exactly 3 scenes. 8.

verification.description: Source 'Overlay Text' exists in 'Main View' scene
Source 'Stage Light' exists in 'Wide Shot' scene

cli_feasibility.translation: Use 'scene list' to find index, then 'source set --name new-name' to rename
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI can rename scenes and sources using 'source set --name new-name' command
